question: Four words are given, out of which only one word is spelt correct. Choose the correct spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **WITHHOLD**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"WITHHOLD"** means to hold back or keep something from being given or shared. (रोकना)

 
 
• **Example: **The company decided to withhold the employee's bonus due to poor performance.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **WITHHOLD**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **SUCCESFUL**: The correct spelling is **"SUCCESSFUL" (सफल)**, meaning achieving the desired aim or result.

 
 
• **Example:** She became a successful entrepreneur at a very young age.
 
 
 
• **RELEVENT**: The correct spelling is **"RELEVANT" (प्रासंगिक****)**, meaning closely connected or appropriate to the matter at hand.
 
 
• **Example: **The professor provided many relevant examples to explain the concept.
 
 
 
• **SUPRISE**: The correct spelling is **"SURPRISE" (आश्चर्य)**, meaning an unexpected or astonishing event, fact, or thing.
 
 
• **Example:** The birthday party was a complete surprise to him.
